ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from inputting values in the 'Contact' or 'Related Account' field for record type: Account to Contact. In addition, it requires both the 'Account' and 'Related Contact (of)' fields to be populated.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: In an 'Account to Contact' relationship, the fields 'Account' and 'Related Contact (of)' are REQUIRED. Do NOT select 'Related Account (of)' or 'Contact' as these are not valid for record type: Account to Contact.
